# Code of Conduct

The Astral Agent project adopts this code of conduct to keep the environment inclusive
and welcoming for everyone involved — new contributors and long-time ones alike.

## Our Purpose

We want to build a project that is:

- inclusive and welcoming to participants from all backgrounds
- accessible to anyone, regardless of technical expertise
- focused on meaningful, positive contributions
- professional and mutually respectful

## Behaviour Standards

### Expected behaviour

- Use warm and inclusive language
- Welcome questions from new participants patiently
- Focus on what can be fixed rather than who to blame
- Acknowledge and appreciate contributions, large and small
- Give feedback constructively and respectfully

### Behaviour that is not expected

- Personal attacks or targeted arguments with other members
- Sexist, racist, religiously charged, or otherwise discriminatory language
- Harassment or intimidating behaviour
- Speaking on behalf of a group ("we all...") unless you actually represent them
- Wasting other people's time, for example with unclear pull requests or issues

## Corrective Action

Violations of this code of conduct are asked to be corrected. Depending on the
severity, that may mean a verbal or written warning, or being processed through a
formal route.

Corrective action may include:

- a verbal or written warning
- a temporary sanction, such as being barred from public project spaces
- a permanent ban from part or all of the community

## Scope

This code of conduct applies to all project spaces and related communication, formal
or informal. We are committed to keeping the environment welcoming for every
participant regardless of age, sex, gender identity, physical ability, level of
experience, geographic location, race, ethnicity, religion or belief, or economic
status.

## Handling Violations

If you experience or witness a violation, contact:

- **Albani Nur Riziq** — project maintainer
- Email: albaninurriziq@gmail.com

A report is typically handled by:

1. understanding the situation and informing the parties involved
2. reviewing the available evidence and information
3. deciding on corrective action proportionate to the violation
4. reporting the outcome back to the relevant community, where applicable

## Attribution

This code of conduct is adapted from the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/), version 2.1, available
at: https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html

Thank you for helping make this community better.
